description: This file defines report-related data structures, constants, and functions for generating user activity reports in Mattermost, including date range calculations, report options validation, and report data formatting.

classes.name: ReportingBaseOptions
classes.description: Holds options for generating reports, including sorting, pagination, and date range.

classes.name: UserReport
classes.description: Represents a user report with user info and post statistics.

classes.name: UserReportOptions
classes.description: Specifies options for filtering and sorting user reports.

classes.name: UserReportQuery
classes.description: Combines user info and post stats for querying reports.

methods.name: GetReportDateRange
methods.description: Calculates start and end timestamps based on a date range string.

methods.name: PopulateDateRange
methods.description: Populates StartAt and EndAt fields based on the current date and the specified date range.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the report options, ensuring date ranges are correct and sorting/filtering options are valid.

methods.name: ToReport
methods.description: Converts user data into a report format.

methods.name: ToReport
methods.description: Converts user query data into a report object.

methods.name: IsValidReportExportFormat
methods.description: Checks if a given export format is supported.
